mapper.select: SELECT id AS quiz_id, course_id, unlimited, time_limit_minutes, start_time AS quiz_start_time, due_time AS quiz_due_time, attempt_limited FROM quizzes WHERE id = #{quizId} AND course_id = #{courseId}
SELECT id AS quiz_id, course_id, unlimited, time_limit_minutes, start_time AS quiz_start_time, due_time AS quiz_due_time, attempt_limited FROM quizzes WHERE id = #{quizId}

SELECT q.id AS question_id, q.type AS question_type, a.answer_number AS correct_answer_number FROM questions q LEFT JOIN answers a ON a.question_id = q.id AND a.is_correct = true WHERE q.quiz_id = #{quizId} ORDER BY q.created_at, a.answer_number
